name: λ-boxes copy through the triangle structure
summary: λ-boxes on both outputs of a structure of Z-spiders, an X-spider and a triangle equal one λ-box on its input.
description:
The same as [(TR13)](../triangle-phase-copy/), but for the λ-box $\mathrm{diag}(1, \lambda)$ instead of a phase.

**Conventions.** The triangle is the matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ read from its tip to its base: a triangle pointing towards the inputs is $|0\rangle\langle 0|+|0\rangle\langle 1|+|1\rangle\langle 1|$, and a triangle pointing towards the outputs is its transpose. It can be written as a Clifford+T ZX-diagram. The papers read diagrams from top to bottom, so their triangles pointing up point towards the inputs here. Scalars that the papers write as diagrams (such as a connected pair of phase-free Z- and X-spiders, which is $\sqrt 2$) are given here as numbers.

The λ-box is the diagonal map $\mathrm{diag}(1, \lambda)$ with $\lambda \geq 0$ (a yellow box in the papers of Ng and Wang, a green box in the LICS'18 paper of Hadzihasanovic, Ng and Wang). Up to the fact that it is drawn differently, it is a Z-box of arity 2 with label $\lambda$. Scalars that the papers write as diagrams are given here as numbers.
unchecked_reason: the triangle and the λ-box are not generators of PyZX or ZXLive
